Reference library for training the ScoutAI planning tool.
STRUCTURE: CORE AXES vs ENHANCEMENT LAYERS
CORE AXES - the tool builds every plan from these. They stand alone.
3. MEASUREMENT (how we prove) - Echo. The ScoutAI-to-Echo handoff.
ENHANCEMENT LAYERS - never stand alone; they ATTACH to a core element and surface only on a trigger.
- Creative & Formats (incl. High Impact Units) - attach to a channel (+audience). Upsell / when execution benefits.
- Inventory & Placement Controls - attach to a channel; govern where-within / how-clean delivery runs.
THE ENHANCEMENT RULE (how the tool decides where a recommendation lives)
Every enhancement entry carries: 'Attaches To' (which channel/axis it rides on) and 'Trigger' (the condition that surfaces it).
The tool recommends CORE AXES first, then walks the enhancement layers and attaches any whose TRIGGER fires.
An enhancement NEVER appears on a plan without a core element to attach to. High Impact Units are never the hero - always an element on a base channel.
Live = deliverable today.  Future = roadmap placeholder, never pitch as live.  Beta = limited availability.

Inventory Controls are an ENHANCEMENT layer, not a core axis: they attach to a channel and govern WHERE-WITHIN / HOW-CLEAN delivery runs. Some ('Default-on') apply to every relevant buy; others surface on a trigger (brand-sensitive vertical, premium goal). Allowlist = 'we only go here'; Blocklist = 'we go everywhere except here'. Never conflate with audience targeting.
